mapper.select:
SELECT pi."name" as productName, COALESCE(pi.spu_no, '') as spuNo, regexp_split_to_table(pt.charge_name,',') as chargeName, 0 as planTaskTime, sum(CASE WHEN pttr.task_time is null THEN 0 else pttr.task_time end)/8 as consumerTime, SUM(case when plan_start_time is not null and plan_end_time is not null then 1 else 0 END) as planTaskNum, count(pt."id") as totalTaskNum, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.status = 4 THEN 1 else 0 end) finishedTaskNum, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.status != 4 THEN 1 else 0 end) unfinishedTaskNum, SUM(CASE WHEN (pt.status = 0 OR pt.status = 1 OR pt.status = 2 OR pt.status = 3) and pt.plan_end_time is not null and pt.plan_end_time < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 else 0 end) delayTaskNum, array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT pt.id),',') taskIds, pi.create_time AS productCreateDate, pi.approval_time AS productApprovalDate FROM "project_task" pt LEFT JOIN product_info pi on pt.product_id = pi.id LEFT JOIN project_task_time_record pttr on pt.id = pttr.project_task_id
pt.is_deleted = FALSE
and (pi."name" like concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword} ,'%') or pi.spu_no like concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword} ,'%'))
and pttr.reality_end_time >= #{params.startDate} and pttr.reality_end_time <= #{params.endDate}
and
#{item} = ANY (string_to_array(pt.charge_id,','))
${param}
GROUP BY pi."name", chargeName,spuNo,pi.create_time,productCreateDate,productApprovalDate ORDER BY pi.create_time DESC
